responsibility: Declares the Go frontend diagnostic API used throughout parsing, type checking, lowering, and import/export code to emit errors, warnings, fatal diagnostics, notes, and debug output with frontend-specific format extensions. It also defines the attribute macros for format checking and the backend callback interface that concrete GCC backend code must implement for message emission and quote-style selection.
same_name_distinction: Declares the frontend diagnostic entry points, format-checking attributes, quote helpers, and backend callback signatures. Unlike go-diagnostics.cc, it specifies the API contract for emitting diagnostics but does not perform format expansion or message forwarding.
